faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Editf Platform

howToStart.question: How do I get started with Editf platform?
howToStart.answer: Very simple! Create your account and start using AI editing features immediately. The platform includes complete AI image generation and editing tools with multi-language support. Start creating right away.

voiceQuality.question: What AI technologies does Editf platform use?
voiceQuality.answer: Editf integrates advanced AI models from leading providers like fal.ai, offering high-quality image generation and editing capabilities. The platform supports multiple AI models and provides efficient, professional content creation tools.

contentOwnership.question: Can I use Editf platform for commercial projects?
contentOwnership.answer: Absolutely! After subscribing to Editf platform, you have full rights to use all AI editing features. Your created content belongs to you completely, and you can use it for any commercial purposes.

dataPrivacy.question: Does Editf platform prioritize user data and content security?
dataPrivacy.answer: Yes, Editf includes comprehensive security measures: secure user authentication, content protection, data encryption, and follows GDPR and other data protection regulations. Your creative content and personal data are fully protected.

videoGeneration.question: Is video generation supported?
videoGeneration.answer: Yes! Editf offers powerful AI video generation with multiple modes: text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-based video generation. We integrate top video models including Seedance, Wan, HappyHorse, Kling, and Veo to create high-quality short video content.

pointsExpiry.question: How long is the Editf template license valid?
pointsExpiry.answer: Editf template license is permanent. Once purchased, you can use it indefinitely, including all future updates and improvements. No recurring fees or subscription required.

upgradeAnytime.question: Can I upgrade my AI editing platform plan anytime?
upgradeAnytime.answer: Absolutely! You can upgrade to a higher version of the AI editing platform anytime. After upgrading, you'll immediately get new features and extended technical support, while your existing license remains valid.

enterpriseFeatures.question: What special features does Enterprise AI editing platform include?
enterpriseFeatures.answer: Enterprise version provides custom AI feature development, private deployment support, 24/7 technical support, team training and consulting, plus dedicated customer success manager services. Completely tailored AI editing solutions according to your creative needs.

faq.question: What is Editf?
faq.answer: Editf is an AI-powered creative platform integrating advanced AI technologies, supporting AI image generation, video creation, image editing, style transfer and more to help users effortlessly create professional-grade images and videos.

faq.question: How do I get started with Editf?
faq.answer: It's simple! After registering an account, you can start creating right away. The platform offers two creative modes: Editor Mode for precise parameter control, and Chat Mode where you can describe your needs in natural language for a more flexible experience.

faq.question: How do I edit existing images?
faq.answer: Upload an image and describe the modifications you want in the input field. The system will automatically recognize the image content and make precise edits. Edit mode consumes additional credits.

faq.question: Is video generation supported?
faq.answer: Yes! Editf offers powerful AI video generation with multiple modes: text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-based video generation. We integrate top video models including Seedance, Wan, HappyHorse, Kling, and Veo to create high-quality short video content.

faq.question: What pricing plans are available?
faq.answer: We offer three plans: Trial, Pro, and Annual. Trial is a one-time purchase that expires after 7 days; Pro and Annual are subscription-based and will auto-renew before expiration with charges applied. You can cancel anytime. Trial can only be purchased once per account.

faq.question: How are credits calculated and recharged?
faq.answer: Each image or video generation consumes corresponding credits, with the amount depending on the model and resolution settings. You can purchase credit packages on the pricing page, and annual subscriptions enjoy more benefits.

faq.question: Can I use generated works for commercial purposes?
